preconDecks.name: ARASAKA CONTROL // ALPHA KIT
preconDecks.description: The official Arasaka starter deck from Alpha Kit. A defensive control deck that uses high-power Units and Corpo agents to dominate the late game.
preconDecks.strategy: Play defensively early. Use Blocker units like Corpo Security to protect your Gigs from direct attacks. Build your board slowly with mid-cost Units.
keyCards: Goro Takemura (Legend - Defensive utility, protects Units)
Corpo Security (Blocker - Your main defensive tool)

preconDecks.name: MERC AGGRO // ALPHA KIT
preconDecks.description: The official Merc starter deck from Alpha Kit. An aggressive rush strategy focused on stealing Gigs fast.
preconDecks.strategy: Go fast. Equip your units with Kiroshi Optics. Attack the opponent directly every turn to steal multiple Gigs. Jackie Welles can GO SOLO for instant attacks.
keyCards: Jackie Welles (Legend - GO SOLO ability for instant attacks)
Viktor Vektor (Legend - Deck searching and economy)
Floor It (Plan - Bounce enemy units to clear the way)
